args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. The rollback tool was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) was re-deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) via the deploy pipeline as a rollback-equivalent action. Rollout verified: service is healthy in all regions, running v2.3.0, with error rate at 0.2%. On-call should monitor health and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any future deploy of that version.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Attempted rollback** to v2.3.0 — the rollback tool returned persistent 503 errors and was not executed.
3. **Alternative path:** re-deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) via the deploy pipeline as a rollback-equivalent action. Rollout verified successfully.
4. **Confirmed recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions, running v2.3.0, with an error rate of 0.2%.
5. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`, on-call paged) documenting the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the rollback-tool outage, and the remediation taken.

Note: v2.3.1 remains unhealthy in the deployment record — it should be investigated before any attempt to re-deploy it.
